# pbs_apt_repositories (Data Source)

Lists the APT repositories of a Proxmox Backup Server node, as the Repositories panel of its interface shows them: every entry of its APT source files, enabled or not, and the standard repositories PBS offers, with whether the node has them. An entry's `file_path` and `index` address it in `pbs_apt_repository`.

Needs `Sys.Audit on /`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_apt_repositories" "this" {}

# The standard repositories the host has enabled, such as ["enterprise"] on
# a fresh installation.
output "enabled_standard_repositories" {
  value = [for r in data.pbs_apt_repositories.this.standard_repositories : r.handle if r.enabled]
}

# Where the enterprise repository's entry is, for a pbs_apt_repository that
# disables it; null when the host has none.
output "enterprise_entry" {
  value = one([
    for r in data.pbs_apt_repositories.this.standard_repositories :
    { file_path = r.file_path, index = r.index } if r.handle == "enterprise" && r.file_path != null
  ])
}

# Files PBS cannot parse, which it leaves out of the list.
output "broken_source_files" {
  value = data.pbs_apt_repositories.this.errors
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) Node to read: `localhost` or the node's host name. Defaults to the provider's `node`.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Digest of the source files together, which changes whenever one of them does.
- `errors` (Attributes List) The source files PBS could not read or parse, which `files` leaves out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--errors))
- `files` (Attributes List) The source files PBS could parse: `/etc/apt/sources.list` first, when there is one, then the files of `/etc/apt/sources.list.d` in the order PBS read them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `infos` (Attributes List) Notes PBS makes on entries, as its interface shows them: their origin, and warnings about suites. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--infos))
- `repositories` (Attributes List) Every entry of the files, enabled or not, file by file in the order of `files`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))
- `standard_repositories` (Attributes List) The standard repositories PBS offers: `enterprise`, `no-subscription` and `test`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--standard_repositories))

<a id="nestedatt--errors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `errors`

Read-Only:

- `error` (String) What PBS found wrong with it.
- `path` (String) Path of the file.


<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Read-Only:

- `digest` (String) SHA-256 digest of the file's content, in hexadecimal.
- `file_type` (String) Format of the file: `list` for one-line entries, `sources` for deb822 stanzas.
- `path` (String) Path of the file.


<a id="nestedatt--infos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `infos`

Read-Only:

- `index` (Number) Index of the entry in the file.
- `kind` (String) Kind of note, such as `origin` or `warning`.
- `message` (String) The note, such as `Proxmox` for the origin of an entry, or a warning.
- `path` (String) Path of the file of the entry.
- `property` (String) Property of the entry the note is about, such as `Suites`; null when it is about the whole entry.


<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment lines above the entry, without their `#`; null when there are none.
- `components` (List of String) Components of the entry, such as `pbs-no-subscription`; empty for an absolute suite.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether APT uses the entry.
- `file_path` (String) Path of the file that holds the entry.
- `file_type` (String) Format of the entry: `list` or `sources`.
- `handle` (String) Standard repository the provider recognises the entry as, such as `enterprise` — the first of `enterprise`, `no-subscription` and `test` whose component the entry lists. Null for other repositories, and for entries PBS 4.2.1 and later count by the key that signs them, such as a local mirror or the download server over `https://`.
- `index` (Number) Position of the entry in its file, from 0.
- `package_types` (List of String) Package types of the entry: `deb`, `deb-src`.
- `suites` (List of String) Suites of the entry, such as `trixie`.
- `uris` (List of String) URIs of the entry.


<a id="nestedatt--standard_repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `standard_repositories`

Read-Only:

- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the node has an entry of the repository, enabled or not.
- `description` (String) Description of the repository as PBS shows it.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the node has an enabled entry of the repository.
- `file_path` (String) Path of the file that holds the repository's first entry; null when the node has none, or when the provider cannot tell which entry PBS counts: PBS 4.2.1 and later also count an entry with another URI, such as a local mirror or the download server over `https://`, by the key that signs it.
- `handle` (String) Handle of the repository, as `pbs_apt_standard_repository` takes it.
- `index` (Number) Index of that entry in the file; null when `file_path` is.
- `name` (String) Name of the repository as PBS shows it, such as `No-Subscription`.
